Although Allegra is a second-generation antihistamine that typically causes little to no sleepiness on its own, pairing it with alcohol can still lead to unexpected sedation—especially with heavier drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXuACA9_r0z3iCpZzV31Z9EjoW-OwobVpYD2dL3qEpgr1jqKCx_WduKKuxCriJni-sgl4HkgCfK5pKtoBlM4rXYQzWsDmsoT7h_Cw8uBze4nqB2ICKMGxKcgIQs8i01k6KlA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF17THojcrtWTMWPI95wK5wRmqMgKGQHOBYIfHJjkQoEExH7LVAR4VPWefUJ8H2wJNpF4h1IGU14F_MsW_Y8AkdeFRtU8cCK3NwFZD0RyIrtHd614k09jukEQOkCSJhoSY4rExL82lRh_BoJI3Og_h4lYxQMfGSQZkqGJVT5k)

### Key Precautions

- **Watch for additive impairment:** Alcohol slows the central nervous system, which can intensify mild side effects like fatigue, poor balance, or slowed reflexes. Avoid driving or operating machinery if you combine them.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmwEBxCJF19LCib586dxbCtDzVybWPF4hj3ou5E5wNxM4Qkczz2RikaDkfR1uiyn-IDC4sozjxP8_RNKr8YpZ2duTK9jquk49ufAnxNBchpiYPqOx63Y7VhNqeVV21lNCHjdUn7aojvIwfEZd38a7EKmbwOON0QNjKf6p9l4nGWQMZ_uRNrbIHYbPc701-DSLRlRJ3LfY9Xt5EvLH9Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXuACA9_r0z3iCpZzV31Z9EjoW-OwobVpYD2dL3qEpgr1jqKCx_WduKKuxCriJni-sgl4HkgCfK5pKtoBlM4rXYQzWsDmsoT7h_Cw8uBze4nqB2ICKMGxKcgIQs8i01k6KlA)
- **Limit amounts if you drink:** Healthcare sources generally advise avoiding alcohol while taking allergy medications, or keeping intake strictly moderate (typically up to 1 drink per day for women and 2 drinks per day for men) after checking with a doctor or pharmacist.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF17THojcrtWTMWPI95wK5wRmqMgKGQHOBYIfHJjkQoEExH7LVAR4VPWefUJ8H2wJNpF4h1IGU14F_MsW_Y8AkdeFRtU8cCK3NwFZD0RyIrtHd614k09jukEQOkCSJhoSY4rExL82lRh_BoJI3Og_h4lYxQMfGSQZkqGJVT5k)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXuACA9_r0z3iCpZzV31Z9EjoW-OwobVpYD2dL3qEpgr1jqKCx_WduKKuxCriJni-sgl4HkgCfK5pKtoBlM4rXYQzWsDmsoT7h_Cw8uBze4nqB2ICKMGxKcgIQs8i01k6KlA)
- **Check combination cold/flu meds:** Avoid pairing Allegra with multi-symptom cold remedies that already contain sedating antihistamines or high doses of acetaminophen if you drink regularly.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXuACA9_r0z3iCpZzV31Z9EjoW-OwobVpYD2dL3qEpgr1jqKCx_WduKKuxCriJni-sgl4HkgCfK5pKtoBlM4rXYQzWsDmsoT7h_Cw8uBze4nqB2ICKMGxKcgIQs8i01k6KlA)
